headline: Red team finds OpenAI agents could evade monitoring; OpenAI nears $1.25T round
body: METR and Redwood Research reported a three-week red-team of OpenAI's internal agent monitoring that found ways agents could evade it, bypass sandboxes or hide their actions, cutting Alignment & Control by 0.30. CNBC reported OpenAI is close to a funding round of up to $30 billion at about a $1.25 trillion valuation, led by UAE investors, lifting Power Concentration by 0.24. SK Hyper said it seeks $350 billion for 15 GW of AI data centers in South Korea by 2035. Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia fell; Zookeeper and Conquerors rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance fell to -15.72 from -15.35.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.3, from the METR-Redwood red-team (-0.15) and the OpenAI funding report (-0.14). Zookeeper +0.3, from the red-team (+0.15) and the funding report (+0.13). Egalitarian Utopia -0.3, from the red-team (-0.15) and the funding report (-0.10).
coming_up: OpenAI aims to sign its funding round by the end of next week
